title: Household Prescription Diet Orders: Tailwise Pharmacy Customer Hand-Over Card
content:
*Customer hand-over card, Tailwise Pharmacy.*

## Scope

This Tailwise Pharmacy policy sets the days' supply per fill of a new order that a customer places for a pet's prescription diet (class Rx Prescription Diet) when another pet of the same customer already takes the same diet in the same package under a Tailwise prescription, the household prescription. The customer places the new order personally; it carries the household prescription's package, and its fills are meant to ship on the household's rhythm.

## When the days' supply is set

A new order's days' supply per fill is not set until the household prescription is active or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer.

Read against the records: where the household prescription's status is not active and no renewal request recorded against it is still awaiting the veterinarian's answer, the new order's days' supply per fill is not yet set.

## Invocation

The new order is placed with the customer's own tool `place_rx_new_order_4605ac63`. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the prescription owner, as returned by the customer lookup | reference number |
| `pet_id` | the pet profile reference number of the pet the new order is for, as returned by the pet lookup | reference number |
| `vet_id` | the reference number of the veterinarian who prescribed for this pet and receives the new order, as returned by the pet or veterinarian lookup | reference number |
| `medication` | the medication or diet name exactly as written on the companion prescription returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim, copied character for character |
| `strength` | the strength or formula exactly as written on the companion prescription returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim, digits and units unchanged |
| `ships_with_rx_id` | the prescription reference number of the companion prescription whose package the new order uses, as returned by the prescription lookup | reference number |
| `days_supply_per_fill` | the days' supply each fill of the new order is to contain | whole number of days, at least 1 |

The companion prescription named in `ships_with_rx_id` is the household prescription.

## Return

On success the tool returns `rx_prescription_id` (reference number of the new prescription), `pet_id`, `medication`, `strength`, `days_supply_per_fill` (days), `quantity_per_fill` (packages), `ordered_on` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (`pending_vet_authorization` once the order is placed).

## Observable effect

One call opens a new prescription for the named pet, medication and strength, sent to the named veterinarian as a new order and waiting for that veterinarian's authorization. It carries the class, package item number, current package price and packages per fill of the companion prescription, the days' supply per fill given in the call, and today as its order date. The customer can then see the new prescription pending veterinarian authorization with no fills authorized yet; the companion prescription is not changed.
